title: Personal Email Newsletter and Inbox Load
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=email:metadata
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as received, sum(eval(if(category="newsletter" OR list_unsubscribe="true",1,0))) as newsletters by _time
| eval newsletter_pct=round(100*newsletters/received)
| sort - _time
description: Trends how much email you receive each week and what share is newsletters, giving you the ammunition for a satisfying unsubscribe session.
value: Inbox overload is mostly newsletters you forgot you signed up for; quantifying the share motivates a cleanup that actually sticks.
implementation: Ingest email metadata (not content) to HEC; schedule weekly and target the newsletter share for pruning.
visualization: Column chart of weekly email received with the newsletter share.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how much email you get each week and how much is newsletters, so you know it is time to unsubscribe.
